name: Shuttle liaison
design: Athletic female adult with golden-brown leopard mottling, four exposed alien mandibles, elongated high forehead, long dreadlocks neatly bundled to one side. Tailored dark charcoal long vest over dark teal wraps, narrow bronze shoulder bands, cream waist cord, two split calf-length panels. Carries a slim faceted navigation tablet at hip and has a small circular communication device on forearm, hand open in restrained welcoming gesture.
